focus: Prove the knee tolerates five running days at 28 miles.
coachNote:
This week is the plan document’s opening week, seeded so the ledger isn’t empty. Five running days, all easy, nothing over nine miles, Monday off running as it will be all year.

The three strength sessions are programmed but deliberately unloaded on paper: the first time you do each lift it is a calibration set. Work up to the rep target at about RPE 7, then log the weight you actually used. Every later block progresses from those numbers rather than a guess.

Before this becomes a real plan it needs your actual history. Sync Strava, then rebuild the plan so the phases and week targets start from the volume you are genuinely carrying.

sessions.title: 30 min technique
sessions.detail: Freestyle only. Drills over yardage. No breaststroke kick.

sessions.title: 5 mi easy
sessions.detail: Conversational the whole way. If the knee talks, cut it short and say so in the note.

sessions.title: Knee rehab + posterior chain
sessions.detail: Rehab-led. This is the priority session of the week, not an accessory.

exercises.note: Isometric hold, knees bent about 60 degrees. Tendon load, not fatigue.
Calibration: work up to a weight you could manage 8 reps with, then stop at 5. Log what you used.
Lighter than the trap bar. Hamstring length under load; stop the set when the back rounds.
Three seconds down. The calf and Achilles carry the running load.
Adductors. Bend the bottom knee to shorten the lever if 20 seconds is too long.

sessions.title: 5 mi easy
sessions.detail: Flat ground. Same effort as Tuesday.

sessions.title: 4 mi easy
sessions.detail: Short by design, so the bike can carry the aerobic work after it.

sessions.title: 45 min easy
sessions.detail: 85-95 rpm, seated. Saddle high enough that the leg is nearly straight at the bottom.

sessions.title: Single-leg + core
sessions.detail: Step-downs, split squats, calf work. Quality over load.

exercises.note: Slow and controlled, knee tracking over the middle toes. This is the knee’s main rehab lift.
Calibration: dumbbells you could do 12 with. Log the weight.
Bodyweight to start. Add load once 10 is comfortable on both sides.
Ribs down, lower back flat on the floor.

sessions.title: Heavy hinge + upper
sessions.detail: Trap bar or RDL, then upper body. Load the hinge properly.

exercises.note: Heavier than Tuesday. Same calibration logic: log the weight so next week has a number to beat.
Glute drive, ribs down, no lower-back arch at the top.
Add weight or use a band as needed. Log whichever you did.
Anti-rotation. Resist the twist rather than producing one.

sessions.title: 9 mi long
sessions.detail: The week's longest run and its only real demand. Easy pace, flat route.

sessions.title: 75 min easy
sessions.detail: Longest ride of the week. Aerobic load the knee doesn't pay for.
